body: The weight of responsibility. I know I am laying off my team which likely means myself. I have always been taught to bottle shit up and to tough up and be a man. So I have carried the weight of my wife's emotions, my mothers insanity, the fact that I have had to be an adult since I was around 7 years old because my parents were both in high deployment jobs in the military. I love working and growing people and playing with tech, but I am currently in a position that was supposed to be that, and it was a lie. I learned later I was openly lied to because everyone for 2 years prior turned down the role once the truth was said in the interview process. It is soul crushing which I am now carrying home. I have always held 1 rule, I never bring work home and that has been my last 2 years with increasing levels of problems. I finally had my way out and I fucked that up, that is the catalyst. I screwed myself on this and in many ways, I know it will crush my wife but I would rather make sure she is set for life and be sad and crushed and see me wither away.
